'''Hexophilenine''' was a substance the use of which for manufacturing [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components was being developed<ref name="TCWnovel" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> The market analysts of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] prognosticated that the use of hexophilenine in the production of hyperdrives would lead to the collapse of the prices of [[teniline]]&mdash;a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] important in hyperdrive manufacture&mdash;within the next five [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TCWnovel" />

Accordingly, when Jabba negotiated a trade deal with the [[Viceroy of Bheriz|viceroy]] of the celestial body [[Bheriz]] that year, the former only increased the amount of teniline Bheriz would have to provide from a quarter of its [[Local year|annual]] output to half its output so that the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] would still acquire the valuable mineral but not be left with too much stock of it.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hexophilenine was mentioned in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" />
